div.div: Groq caps the Generator at ~8K tokens per minute, so any large section failed with 413 on every retry. Moved to NIM, then OpenRouter with a disclosed $10 top-up.

div.div: SummaryIndex has no real traversal, so the structural arm would have been a flat scan. TreeIndex gives a genuine root-to-leaf retriever with no query-time LLM call.

div.div: "A three-provider fallback chain was necessary to run a 900-cell LLM benchmark on free tiers" is a reproducibility result about the infrastructure available to an unfunded researcher. It belongs in the dissertation, not in a git history.

div.div: The P1 metadata leak shows that fairness in a controlled retrieval comparison has to be enforced in code. It failed silently until review caught it.
